title: Indoor localization and camera pose
purpose: Determine the user's pose inside a store from visual-inertial sensing, marker anchors and the store map, with honest, calibrated confidence.
architecturalScope: Localization bounded context. LocalizationPort and MarkerDetector. Feeds Navigation. Concrete SLAM/VIO engines are infrastructure adapters.
domainContext: Position, Pose, Heading, LocalizationState, Confidence, Anchor, LocalizationSession aggregate. Emits LocalizationLost / LocalizationRecovered.

milestones.title: Marker-based coarse localization
milestones.description: AprilTag/ArUco anchors plus dead reckoning yield <2 m accuracy on the test market.

milestones.title: Visual-inertial odometry integration
milestones.description: A VIO adapter provides pose between marker resets.

milestones.title: Map relocalization
milestones.description: Localization recovers against a visual map without infrastructure markers.

tasks.title: Evaluate marker vs VIO vs WiFi/BLE approaches
tasks.description: Compare accuracy, cost, infrastructure needs and licensing.
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison report with a staged recommendation (marker first).

tasks.title: Define LocalizationPort and LocalizationState
acceptanceCriteria: Domain tests cover loss, recovery and stale observations.

tasks.title: Evaluate open VIO/SLAM engines and licenses
tasks.description: OpenVINS, RTAB-Map, ORB-SLAM3, Basalt plus ARCore.
acceptanceCriteria: License matrix documented; copyleft engines isolated if used.

tasks.title: Prototype map-based relocalization
tasks.description: Relocalize against a pre-built visual map of the test market.
acceptanceCriteria: Reported position error and recovery time vs marker baseline.
Coarse position error < 2 m after a marker reset on the test market.
Localization loss is always announced and never hidden.
The localization adapter is replaceable without domain changes.

risks.description: Drift makes position unusable over longer routes.
risks.mitigation: Marker resets, VIO fusion, confidence decay, explicit lost-state.

risks.description: Strong VIO engines are GPL, limiting distribution.
risks.mitigation: Prefer permissive/ native options; isolate copyleft engines behind a service boundary.

safetyImplications: Never emit a spatial claim without evidence from sensors/map/validated perception (AGENTS.md 19).
On uncertainty: STOP, reacquire, reassess rather than guess.
accessibilityImplications: Localization state must be expressed audibly (e.g. 'I am not sure where we are').
privacyImplications: No persistent location history; pose is ephemeral.
Camera frames used for localization are not stored.
verificationRequirements: Localization error measurement on the test market.
